coverageNote: Read all 36 current Markdown sources under .memory/wiki/specs/ideation/15-gear-registry-ownership/ across six audit units. Every source underwent 3a implementer simulation, 3b Vision Rubric scoring, and 3c devil's-advocate probing. Applied 48 checkpoints (six units × eight Vision Rubric dimensions). Freshness preserved: no audit artifacts were read.
